name: Strawberry Darling
source:
You work at a cute cafe with a creepy boss and amazing coworker, but at this cafe there is also a strange regular.

Airi Lovegood is obsessed with you for such trivial reasons, how far will this obsession go?

[From [url=https://rosewoodstudios.itch.io/strawberry-darling]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一家可爱的咖啡馆打工，店里有位阴森古怪的老板和一位人超好的同事，但同时还有一名行径奇特的常客。

爱莉·洛夫古德因为某些微不足道的理由对你痴迷不已——这份执念究竟会疯狂到何种地步？

[摘自[url=https://rosewoodstudios.itch.io/strawberry-darling]itch.io[/url]]
